fact: The RPPA Director General said the Umucyo e-procurement system was launched on 27 June 2016 in 8 pilot government institutions, with all government institutions to use it from April 2017.
Open Contracting Partnership says Rwanda's Umucyo e-procurement system is used by all national and local government agencies.
Open Contracting Partnership says Umucyo is used by all national and local government agencies for almost all procurement procedures.
The RPPA survey says Umucyo was rolled out to all government institutions in 2017 and is used by about 200 procuring entities and over 5,000 bidders.

The RPPA survey says Umucyo covers planning, bidding, awarding, contracting, purchasing and contract management, and law 62/2018 requires all public procurement to use it unless RPPA authorises otherwise.
The RPPA survey reports about 200 procuring entities and over 5,000 bidders on Umucyo and an overall user satisfaction of 79.5%.
